title: 3 Night Shift Horror Stories Animated
description:
Three night shifts on the same stretch of Route 9. A gas station with ten rules taped under the register. A hospital room whose call light comes on every night, three years after its patient went home. A motel guest who checks into room nine at 3:33 a.m. Stay for the last story: it explains the first.
